## About
Texas Veterinary Ophthalmology is a specialty referral practice located in Fort Worth, Texas. Our ophthalmologist is Dr. Brian Cichocki, DVM, DACVO, and you'll find us at 818 West Terrell Avenue.
When something is wrong with your pet's eyes, it can be a stressful time. Owners who have been through it with us talk about a team that was kind, patient and gentle with their dogs and cats, from a tiny teacup Chihuahua to an Olde English Bulldogge.
We hold a 4.8 rating from 89 Google reviews.

## Services
- Eye removal: One owner's dog, Lil'Bit, was suffering from glaucoma and needed a double eye removal. She is recovering beautifully and is much more comfortable now.
- Entropion of the eyelid: Care for eyelids that roll inward. One owner brought in her Olde English Bulldogge and said Dr. Cichocki did an amazing job.
- New eyelids: For a cat born without eyelids, Dr. Cichocki made new eyelids from the margin of his lips. That cat went on to a great home.

## FAQ
Q: Who is the ophthalmologist?
A: Our ophthalmologist is Dr. Brian Cichocki, DVM, DACVO.

Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: I'm a referring veterinarian. How do I reach you?
A: Referring DVMs can email referrals@texasvo.com. A Referral Form is also available on our Forms page.
